view: Downward and forward aerial panorama plus lake aerial, reviewed east/west lake arms and the south approach to the Xiang plaza junction.
registration: Topology matched by lake, library and two road junctions to OSM way 1076344082 v2. OSM centerline and shared WGS84 origin retained. Lamp stations are approximate road-relative placements, not photogrammetric coordinates. Lake southern/eastern and western arms now bounded by lakeside-environment.json; historical photo presence and relative roadside positions only.
occlusion: 树冠遮挡部分路缘；三岔口短暂缺少步道和树篱，白色外缘仍连续圆润相接，范围见 lakeside-environment.json。
precision: 道路沿用 OSM 两条7米车道基底。白线宽0.10米、距道路中心3.08米，圆角裁切最多2米；三岔口及隔离带鼻端按用户俯视照片估计，非实测。中央隔离带取代旧单幅引道，不再在绿带中画黄色中线。灯杆及其余尺寸沿用既有照片估计。

withheld.crossings: Photos confirm crossings, but exact cross-road registration/extent has not been established; do not place zebra crossings on guessed chainages.
withheld.bridge: OSM way 309375782 v7 locates Xueyuan Bridge. Aerial appearance and 2026-01-05 repair photos confirm covered curved ribs, turquoise roof, metal deck and 5 cm anti-slip strips. Absolute deck profile, stair/landing plan and support coordinates are not supplied. Hold the connected bridge model until these are registered; do not fit an arbitrary hump to terrain.
withheld.lighting_2026: 2026-06-24 official report confirms 66 replaced/new LED fixtures at more than 10 locations, without a location schedule. The fourteen estimated poles represent only visible historical fixtures, not the whole upgrade.

annotation_20260922.basis: 第一处保持连续沥青和白色外缘，不铺红步道或树篱；后两处补两盏既有造型路灯。灯基沿东侧环湖路与南向引道外侧约定位，树冠遮挡底座，非实测坐标。
